events.headline: Iran prepares to announce a restricted zone near the Strait of Hormuz as IRGC claims new attacks on US warships; US and Iran continue trading strikes in the strait over the weekend

Brent crude trades near $95.73/bbl, up more than 8% for the week (its strongest weekly performance since July) as escalating US-Iran conflict raises concern over disrupted crude supply through the Strait of Hormuz

Xi and Trump meet in Washington with the global critical-minerals order at stake; China rare-earth firms halt some US shipments over geopolitical worries ahead of the Nov. 10 expiry of Beijing's export-control suspension

A stronger-than-expected jobs report pushes the 2-year Treasury yield to its highest since January 2025, keeping market-implied odds of a September Fed rate hike near 50% (down from ~63% a day earlier) amid a still-hawkish tone from Chair Warsh

Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for roughly $12.9B to expand its AI developer platform, as Semicon Taiwan 2026 draws record attendance and TSMC/Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron report memory and foundry capacity sold out through 2027 on AI chip demand
